payload.content: Render triage on Eve's Excalidraw export path. Three reported symptoms may be three separate bugs. Keep them separated: for each, state what renders correctly, what is wrong, and what is still unverified. Use exportToSvg / exportToCanvas as the entry points. Do not fix until each is isolated.

Three export complaints landed together: (1) text uses a system fallback font in SVG export instead of the hand-drawn font, (2) PNG export looks blurry on my retina display, (3) when I export a grouped frame the bounding box clips the right edge. Please triage these as separate issues before fixing anything.

summary.text: These are three independent paths. (1) SVG fonts: exportToSvg must embed @font-face or the browser falls back; likely the font isn't inlined. (2) HiDPI blur: PNG raster path probably exports at scale:1 regardless of devicePixelRatio. (3) Grouped-frame clip: the export bbox is computed from element bounds but a frame's children may extend past the frame, or stroke width isn't added to the bbox. I'll read the SVG export, the canvas export, and the bbox computation separately and verify each with a targeted run rather than conflating them.

payload.content: Issue 1 isolated and confirmed wrong: exportSvg.ts references the Virgil font by family name but never embeds it, so a standalone SVG opened outside Eve falls back to serif. Renders correctly only when the host page already has Virgil loaded — which is why it looks fine in-app and breaks when exported. The fix will be embedding @font-face with the woff2 as a data URI, but per scope I'm isolating first. Moving to the PNG path.

summary.text: Issue 2 is independent of issue 1 and is confirmed: getDimensions hardcodes scale:1, so on a dpr=2 display the raster has half the pixels it needs and the browser upscales it, producing blur. The earlier sketch-to-diagram path used scale:2 and looked crisp, which corroborates this. Fix later is scale: Math.max(2, window.devicePixelRatio). Now the grouped-frame clip — I expect the bbox computation, not the export call itself.

VERDICT: ISSUE 3 -- bbox math is FINE; the bug is the element SELECTION feeding it (children of the frame are filtered out before bounds are computed). NEEDS one more check on the selection filter to confirm.

lib/canvas/exportSelection.ts
14:  const frame = selected
15:  const els = elements.filter((e) => e.id === frame.id)  // <-- only the frame itself, not e.frameId === frame.id

summary.text: Now all three are cleanly separated and grounded. (1) SVG fonts: WRONG, font not embedded. (2) HiDPI blur: WRONG, scale hardcoded to 1. (3) Grouped-frame clip: the bbox math in bbox.ts is CORRECT; the real defect is upstream in exportSelection.ts which filters to e.id === frame.id and drops the frame's children (should also include e.frameId === frame.id), so children that extend past the frame are excluded from bounds and clipped. The third was initially misattributed to bbox — verifying the selection filter is what disproved that. Three separate one-area fixes, no shared root cause.

payload.content: Triage complete — three independent issues, each isolated to a different file. ISSUE 1 (SVG fonts) WRONG: exportSvg.ts references Virgil by name but never embeds @font-face, so standalone SVGs fall back to serif; renders right only when the host page has the font. Fix: inline the woff2 as a data URI. ISSUE 2 (HiDPI blur) WRONG: exportScene.ts hardcodes getDimensions scale:1, ignoring devicePixelRatio, so retina exports are upscaled and blurry. Fix: scale = Math.max(2, devicePixelRatio). ISSUE 3 (grouped-frame clip): the bbox math in bbox.ts is CORRECT and was a red herring — the real bug is exportSelection.ts filtering to e.id === frame.id and dropping children (e.frameId === frame.id), so child text past the frame edge is excluded from bounds and clipped. Unverified/follow-up: whether nested frames (frame-in-frame) need recursive child collection — not reproduced here. Recommend three separate small PRs, one per file.
